d:
Bangladesh says deposed Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina can return to the country through a prisoner exchange under the India-Bangladesh extradition treaty, as her legal team seeks a fresh passport.
Also in focus: Delhi’s air quality worsens after Deepavali, with the AQI reaching 370; Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s remarks on “Dimagi Naxals” draw a sharp response from the Congress; Keralam orders inspections at petrol pumps over concerns about excess ethanol in fuel; and COP31 begins in Turkey, with countries discussing climate action and energy transition.
